elements.name: passenger seated on worn bus seat
only head, shoulders and top of seat back in view
steep forested mountain slopes of Ethiopian highlands

wrong_setting: The huge single panoramic window and the open standing floor in front of it read more like a train or observation car than an old country bus; the mountains, with dense conifer forest, look more alpine than Ethiopian highland.
notes: Repaint as a close shot from behind with the passenger seated on a worn bus seat, showing only his head, shoulders and the seat top, with the backpack on his lap and a row of small bus windows along the wall, instead of him standing full-length at one giant window wearing the backpack.
